description:
Reads a player's save game that was stored with horizon_save_cloud_data.
Use when: the game starts or the player switches devices and needs the saved progress.
Not for: writing (use horizon_save_cloud_data) or balances of server-owned values (use horizon_get_state).
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {found, saveData, revision}. found false with saveData null means the player never saved: this is normal on first start, so initialize default data. revision is the save's server revision (0 = empty slot, 1 after the first save): pass it as expectedRevision to horizon_save_cloud_data. revision null means the server sent none (unknown state, for example a self-hosted simpleServer), not an empty slot.
Errors: 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

sessionToken.description: accessToken from horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous for this userId; sent as a Bearer session

userId.description: Player user ID (UUID) from horizon_signup_* or horizon_signin_*

name: horizon_load_cloud_data

anyOf.description: false when the player never saved
Server revision (0 = empty slot), to pass as expectedRevision when saving. Null when unknown
The stored save string, null when found is false

title: Load Cloud Data
